about.heading: Senior Technician-Led HVAC Expertise
about.body: CaloWet Air is a professional HVAC company founded and led by senior certified technicians with over a decade of hands-on experience. We serve homes, hotels, corporate offices, and real estate developments across Nyanza, Western, Central, Nairobi, and Rift Valley regions.
about.mission: Our mission is to deliver reliable installations, smart product guidance, and long-term maintenance for every client — from a single home unit to a full commercial cooling system.

items.title: Certified Technicians
items.body: Every installation and service is handled by senior technicians with industry certifications and proven field experience.

items.title: Genuine Equipment
items.body: We stock and install only genuine HVAC products from verified brands — no counterfeits, no shortcuts.

items.title: Regional Coverage
items.body: Headquartered to serve Nyanza, Western, Central, Nairobi, and Rift Valley — we go where competitors don't.

items.title: End-to-End Service
